empty.error: nothing to import: paste a share code

not_a_code.error: that doesn't look like a share code (they start with KTF1-)

newer.error: this code was made by a newer version (code format 9; this one reads up to 1): update Kick the Fly to import it

short.error: the code is too short: part of it is missing

bad_char.error: the code has characters that aren't part of a share code

checksum.error: the code is damaged (its checksum doesn't match): a character was mistyped or part is missing

kind_mismatch.error: the code's header doesn't match its contents
